sample_unit: curated cases (600 clinician-LLM interactions; 159 human clinicians)
unlisted_practices: Benchmarking LLM elicitation of patients' hidden concerns via multi-turn dialogue with an interactive patient simulator
Evaluating LLM ability to address the primary concern and guide patients to a target plan compared with human clinicians

screen.reason: The paper introduces MedConceal, an interactive simulated benchmark to evaluate LLM hidden-concern reasoning in medical dialogue, comparing LLMs with human clinicians without testing a specific organizational guardrail or deployment practice.
